responsibility: Defines the user-visible target options for the M32C backend and their storage variables. It introduces CPU-selection switches for the supported R8C/M16C/M32CM/M32C variants, the simulator-runtime option, and the memregs tuning option, allowing option processing to drive target_cpu/target_memregs decisions later consumed by the backend and pragma code.
same_name_distinction: Option-definition file for the m32c stem, separate from the backend code in m32c.cc, the target macros in m32c.h, and the RTL machine descriptions in m32c.md; it declares user-visible target switches and the generated variables such as target_cpu and target_memregs that the rest of the port reads.
